cat > /app/tmp/t/t1_envelope.py << 'PYEOF'
import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, '/app/tmp/t')
from harness import *

def ok_env(events=None, cfg=None):
    return envelope(events or [], cfg)

# 1. minimal valid envelope: no events
rc, out, err = run(ok_env())
expect("empty events", rc == 0 and json.loads(out) == {"results": [], "accepted": 0, "replayed": 0, "rejected": 0, "live": 0}, out[:200])

# 2. envelope key problems
rc, out, err = run({"version": 1, "config": base_config()})
expect("missing events", rc == 2 and out == b"", (rc, out[:100]))
rc, out, err = run({"version": 1, "config": base_config(), "events": [], "extra": 1})
expect("extra top key", rc == 2, (rc, out[:100]))
rc, out, err = run({"version": 2, "config": base_config(), "events": []})
expect("bad version", rc == 2, rc)
rc, out, err = run({"version": True, "config": base_config(), "events": []})
expect("version bool", rc == 2, rc)
rc, out, err = run({"version": 1.0, "config": base_config(), "events": []})
expect("version float", rc == 2, rc)
rc, out, err = run('{"version": 1, "version": 1, "config": {"accounts": [], "peers": [{"id":"p","mode":"access","accounts":[]}], "ttl_ms": 1, "capacity": 1}, "events": []}')
expect("dup key", rc == 2, rc)
rc, out, err = run('{"version": 1, "config": {"accounts": [], "peers": [{"id":"p","mode":"access","accounts":[]}], "ttl_ms": 1, "capacity": 1, "ttl_ms": 2}, "events": []}')
expect("dup key nested", rc == 2, rc)
rc, out, err = run('{"version": 1, "config": {"accounts": [], "peers": [{"id":"p","mode":"access","accounts":[]}], "ttl_ms": NaN, "capacity": 1}, "events": []}')
expect("NaN", rc == 2, rc)
rc, out, err = run('{"version": 1, "config": {"accounts": [], "peers": [{"id":"p","mode":"access","accounts":[]}], "ttl_ms": 1, "capacity": 1}, "events": [{"t": 1e2, "peer":"p","auth":null,"egress":"internal","wire_hex":""}]}')
expect("exponent int", rc == 2, rc)
rc, out, err = run(b'\xef\xbb\xbf' + b'{"version":1}')
expect("BOM", rc == 2, rc)
rc, out, err = run(b'{"version":1, "config": {"accounts": [], "peers": [{"id":"p","mode":"access","accounts":[]}], "ttl_ms": 1, "capacity": 1}, "events": []} trailing')
expect("trailing junk", rc == 2, rc)
rc, out, err = run(b'{"version":1, "config": {"accounts": [], "peers": [{"id":"p","mode":"access","accounts":[]}], "ttl_ms": 1, "capacity": 1}, "events": []}\xff')
expect("bad utf8", rc == 2, rc)
rc, out, err = run(b'')
expect("empty input", rc == 2, rc)
rc, out, err = run(b'[1,2,3]')
expect("not object", rc == 2, rc)
rc, out, err = run(b'{"version":1 "config":{}}')
expect("malformed json", rc == 2, rc)

# 3. config validation
def cfg_with(**kw):
    c = base_config()
    c.update(kw)
    return c

rc, _, _ = run(envelope([], cfg_with(ttl_ms=0)))
expect("ttl 0", rc == 2, rc)
rc, _, _ = run(envelope([], cfg_with(ttl_ms=1000001)))
expect("ttl big", rc == 2, rc)
rc, _, _ = run(envelope([], cfg_with(ttl_ms=True)))
expect("ttl bool", rc == 2, rc)
rc, _, _ = run(envelope([], cfg_with(capacity=0)))
expect("cap 0", rc == 2, rc)
rc, _, _ = run(envelope([], cfg_with(capacity=10001)))
expect("cap big", rc == 2, rc)
rc, _, _ = run(envelope([], cfg_with(accounts=[])))
expect("accounts empty ok", rc == 0, rc)
rc, _, _ = run(envelope([], cfg_with(peers=[])))
expect("peers empty", rc == 2, rc)
rc, _, _ = run(envelope([], {"accounts": [{"id":"a","default":"sip:a@x.test","aliases":["sip:a@x.test"]}], "peers": [{"id":"p","mode":"access","accounts":["a"]}], "ttl_ms":1, "capacity":1}))
expect("access with accounts", rc == 2, rc)
rc, _, _ = run(envelope([], {"accounts": [{"id":"a","default":"sip:a@x.test","aliases":["sip:a@x.test"]}], "peers": [{"id":"p","mode":"relay","accounts":["a","a"]}], "ttl_ms":1, "capacity":1}))
expect("relay dup accounts", rc == 2, rc)
rc, _, _ = run(envelope([], {"accounts": [{"id":"a","default":"sip:a@x.test","aliases":["sip:a@x.test"]}], "peers": [{"id":"p","mode":"relay","accounts":["zzz"]}], "ttl_ms":1, "capacity":1}))
expect("relay unknown account", rc == 2, rc)
rc, _, _ = run(envelope([], {"accounts": [{"id":"a","default":"sip:a@x.test","aliases":["sip:a@x.test"]}], "peers": [{"id":"p","mode":"relay","accounts":[]}], "ttl_ms":1, "capacity":1}))
expect("relay empty accounts ok", rc == 0, rc)
rc, _, _ = run(envelope([], {"accounts": [{"id":"a","default":"sip:a@x.test","aliases":["sip:a@x.test"]}], "peers": [{"id":"p","mode":"gateway","accounts":[]}], "ttl_ms":1, "capacity":1}))
expect("bad mode", rc == 2, rc)
rc, _, _ = run(envelope([], {"accounts": [{"id":"1a","default":"sip:a@x.test","aliases":["sip:a@x.test"]}], "peers": [{"id":"p","mode":"access","accounts":[]}], "ttl_ms":1,"capacity":1}))
expect("bad acct id start", rc == 2, rc)
rc, _, _ = run(envelope([], {"accounts": [{"id":"a"*33,"default":"sip:a@x.test","aliases":["sip:a@x.test"]}], "peers": [{"id":"p","mode":"access","accounts":[]}], "ttl_ms":1,"capacity":1}))
expect("acct id too long", rc == 2, rc)
rc, _, _ = run(envelope([], {"accounts": [{"id":"a","default":"sip:a@x.test","aliases":["sip:a@x.test"]},{"id":"a","default":"sip:b@x.test","aliases":["sip:b@x.test"]}], "peers": [{"id":"p","mode":"access","accounts":[]}], "ttl_ms":1,"capacity":1}))
expect("dup acct id", rc == 2, rc)
rc, _, _ = run(envelope([], {"accounts": [{"id":"a","default":"SIP:a@x.test","aliases":["SIP:a@x.test"]}], "peers": [{"id":"p","mode":"access","accounts":[]}], "ttl_ms":1,"capacity":1}))
expect("alias not canonical (case)", rc == 2, rc)
rc, _, _ = run(envelope([], {"accounts": [{"id":"a","default":"sip:a@x.test","aliases":["sip:a@x.test","sip:a@x.test:5060"]}], "peers": [{"id":"p","mode":"access","accounts":[]}], "ttl_ms":1,"capacity":1}))
expect("alias with port ok", rc == 0, rc)
rc, _, _ = run(envelope([], {"accounts": [{"id":"a","default":"sip:a@x.test","aliases":["sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid"]}], "peers": [{"id":"p","mode":"access","accounts":[]}], "ttl_ms":1,"capacity":1}))
expect("anonymous alias", rc == 2, rc)
rc, _, _ = run(envelope([], {"accounts": [{"id":"a","default":"sip:b@x.test","aliases":["sip:a@x.test","sip:b@x.test"]}], "peers": [{"id":"p","mode":"access","accounts":[]}], "ttl_ms":1,"capacity":1}))
expect("default is alias ok", rc == 0, rc)
rc, _, _ = run(envelope([], {"accounts": [{"id":"a","default":"sip:zz@x.test","aliases":["sip:a@x.test"]}], "peers": [{"id":"p","mode":"access","accounts":[]}], "ttl_ms":1,"capacity":1}))
expect("default not alias", rc == 2, rc)
rc, _, _ = run(envelope([], {"accounts": [{"id":"a","default":"sip:a@x.test","aliases":["sip:a@x.test"]},{"id":"b","default":"sip:b@x.test","aliases":["sip:a@x.test","sip:b@x.test"]}], "peers": [{"id":"p","mode":"access","accounts":[]}], "ttl_ms":1,"capacity":1}))
expect("alias two accounts", rc == 2, rc)
rc, _, _ = run(envelope([], {"accounts": [{"id":"a","default":"sip:a@x.test","aliases":[]}], "peers": [{"id":"p","mode":"access","accounts":[]}], "ttl_ms":1,"capacity":1}))
expect("aliases empty", rc == 2, rc)
rc, _, _ = run(envelope([], {"accounts": [{"id":"a","default":"sip:a@x.test","aliases":["sip:a%d@x.test"]}], "peers": [{"id":"p","mode":"access","accounts":[]}], "ttl_ms":1,"capacity":1}))
expect("alias bad escape", rc == 2, rc)
rc, _, _ = run(envelope([], {"accounts": [{"id":"a","default":"tel:+1-2.3(4)5","aliases":["tel:+1-2.3(4)5"]}], "peers": [{"id":"p","mode":"access","accounts":[]}], "ttl_ms":1,"capacity":1}))
expect("tel alias non-canonical", rc == 2, rc)

# 4. events validation
good = mkreq(headers=std_headers())
e = [ev(0, "edge", "alice", "external", h(good))]
rc, out, err = run(envelope(e))
expect("basic accept", rc == 0 and json.loads(out)["results"][0]["decision"] == "accept", out[:300])

e = [ev(5, "edge", "alice", "external", h(good)), ev(4, "edge", "alice", "external", h(good))]
rc, _, _ = run(envelope(e))
expect("descending time", rc == 2, rc)
e = [ev(5, "edge", "alice", "external", h(good)), ev(5, "edge", "alice", "external", h(good))]
rc, _, _ = run(envelope(e))
expect("equal time ok", rc == 0, rc)
rc, _, _ = run(envelope([ev(-1, "edge", "alice", "external", h(good))]))
expect("negative t", rc == 2, rc)
rc, _, _ = run(envelope([ev(9007199254740991, "edge", "alice", "external", h(good))]))
expect("max t", rc == 0, rc)
rc, _, _ = run(envelope([ev(9007199254740992, "edge", "alice", "external", h(good))]))
expect("over max t", rc == 2, rc)
rc, _, _ = run(envelope([ev(0, "nosuch", "alice", "external", h(good))]))
expect("unknown peer", rc == 2, rc)
rc, _, _ = run(envelope([ev(0, "edge", "nosuch", "external", h(good))]))
expect("unknown auth", rc == 2, rc)
rc, _, _ = run(envelope([ev(0, "trunk", "alice", "external", h(good))]))
expect("relay with auth", rc == 2, rc)
rc, _, _ = run(envelope([ev(0, "edge", "alice", "internal", h(good))]))
expect("internal egress ok", rc == 0, rc)
rc, _, _ = run(envelope([ev(0, "edge", "alice", "both", h(good))]))
expect("bad egress", rc == 2, rc)
rc, _, _ = run(envelope([ev(0, "edge", "alice", "external", "zz")]))
expect("odd hex is event reject", rc == 0 and json.loads(out if False else b'{}') == {} or True, rc)
r = json.loads(run(envelope([ev(0, "edge", "alice", "external", "zz")])[1])
expect("odd hex reason", r["results"][0]["reason"] == "hex", r)
rc, _, _ = run(envelope([ev(0, "edge", "alice", "external", "x" * 131073)]))
expect("wire_hex too long", rc == 2, rc)
rc, out, _ = run(envelope([ev(0, "edge", "alice", "external", "4d")]))
expect("wire_hex 2 chars ok", rc == 0, rc)
rc, _, _ = run(envelope([{"t":0,"peer":"edge","auth":"alice","egress":"external"}]))
expect("event missing key", rc == 2, rc)
rc, _, _ = run(envelope([{"t":0,"peer":"edge","auth":"alice","egress":"external","wire_hex":"","x":1}]))
expect("event extra key", rc == 2, rc)
rc, _, _ = run(envelope([{"t":0,"peer":"edge","auth":"alice","egress":"external","wire_hex":5}]))
expect("wire_hex not str", rc == 2, rc)
rc, _, _ = run(envelope([{"t":0,"peer":5,"auth":"alice","egress":"external","wire_hex":""}]))
expect("peer not str", rc == 2, rc)
# events > 10000
big = [ev(i, "edge", "alice", "external", "") for i in range(10001)]
rc, _, _ = run(envelope(big))
expect("10001 events", rc == 2, rc)
big = [ev(i, "edge", "alice", "external", "") for i in range(10000)]
rc, out, _ = run(envelope(big))
expect("10000 events ok", rc == 0 and json.loads(out)["rejected"] == 10000, rc)
# accounts 256 ok / 257 bad
accts = [{"id": f"a{i}", "default": f"sip:a{i}@x.test", "aliases": [f"sip:a{i}@x.test"]} for i in range(256)]
rc, _, _ = run(envelope([], {"accounts": accts, "peers": [{"id":"p","mode":"access","accounts":[]}], "ttl_ms":1,"capacity":1}))
expect("256 accounts", rc == 0, rc)
accts.append({"id": "a257", "default": "sip:a257@x.test", "aliases": ["sip:a257@x.test"]})
rc, _, _ = run(envelope([], {"accounts": accts, "peers": [{"id":"p","mode":"access","accounts":[]}], "ttl_ms":1,"capacity":1}))
expect("257 accounts", rc == 2, rc)
# aliases 8 ok, 9 bad
al = [f"sip:a{i}@x.test" for i in range(8)]
rc, _, _ = run(envelope([], {"accounts": [{"id":"a","default":al[0],"aliases":al}], "peers":[{"id":"p","mode":"access","accounts":[]}],"ttl_ms":1,"capacity":1}))
expect("8 aliases", rc == 0, rc)
al.append("sip:a8@x.test")
rc, _, _ = run(envelope([], {"accounts": [{"id":"a","default":al[0],"aliases":al}], "peers":[{"id":"p","mode":"access","accounts":[]}],"ttl_ms":1,"capacity":1}))
expect("9 aliases", rc == 2, rc)
# peers 256 ok
prs = [{"id": f"p{i}", "mode": "access", "accounts": []} for i in range(256)]
rc, _, _ = run(envelope([], {"accounts": [], "peers": prs, "ttl_ms":1,"capacity":1}))
expect("256 peers", rc == 0, rc)
prs.append({"id":"p256","mode":"access","accounts":[]})
rc, _, _ = run(envelope([], {"accounts": [], "peers": prs, "ttl_ms":1,"capacity":1}))
expect("257 peers", rc == 2, rc)
summary()
